The new body, which will be launched next week, will include prominent figures from the European Union as well as the United Kingdom and Ukraine, she announced at the start of an informal defense ministers' meeting in Ireland. "Every day spent in war pushes humanity back, and every step taken towards peace fills humanity with new hope and enthusiasm," Modi said on Monday. Modi, whose country's economy depends heavily on discounted oil from Moscow, has made several similar pleas to Putin since he launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. stories.article_text_excerpt: Image source, Getty Images By James Gregory Published 1 September 2026, 16:43 BST Updated 3 minutes ago Germany has said Russia was responsible for last month's drone attack at Leipzig's airport. A drone carrying an explosive device was discovered at Leipzig/Halle Airport in eastern Germany, close to Ukrainian cargo planes, on 4 August. It failed to explode as the detonator was apparently faulty, and investigators suspect a second drone collided with a cargo aircraft nearby. A third drone was reportedly found near the airport 10 days later. Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt said the Leipzig airport attack followed the "well-established pattern of Russian hybrid operations in Europe" and the assumption was that Germany would be targeted again. Security experts had speculated that Russia may have been responsible, however Russia has always rejected claims of involvement. Leipzig/Halle Airport in eastern Germany is used by the Germany military and Nato allies for the transport of military goods and also serves as a base for Ukraine's Antonov Airlines - which carries most of the country's aerial cargo. stories.article_text_excerpt: Nearly 5% of goods entering the EU are fake, costing businesses an estimated €83 billion annually. At the port of Alicante, OLAF and Spanish Customs officers sift through shipping containers, hunting for counterfeit products hidden in plain sight among legitimate trade. Experts describe illicit trade as a sophisticated global business model, no longer limited to luxury items but now spanning car parts, electronics, pharmaceuticals and food. Counterfeit car components pose particular risks, as they bypass safety testing entirely. Officials stress that buying fakes helps finance serious crimes, including drug and human trafficking, urging shoppers to think twice before chasing a bargain.

But a group of lumpen creatures known as sea cucumbers are at the center of a $200 million (€175 million) black market trade. Known alternately and misleadingly as sea cucumbers or sand fish, they are actually neither cucumbers nor fish, but echinoderms. In other words, invertebrate marine animals with a skin or a hard covering. Found in abundance around the Andaman Islands — the easternmost landmass of the Indian territory — local biologist Sangamesh Uday said they are so ecologically important that without them the intertidal zone "wouldn't be an ecosystem, it would just be broken rocks." stories.article_text_excerpt: Image source, Reuters Image caption, Ayten Bicer and Hayri Bicer's two children are missing By James Gregory Published 31 August 2026 Ayten Bicer felt her 12-year-old daughter slip from her grasp and disappear as the ferry they were travelling on capsized off the coast of northern Cyprus on Sunday, killing eight people. Her daughter Miray and six-year-old son Memhet Asaf are among 20 people still missing after the vessel sunk while en route to Turkey from the coastal town of Kyrenia, in the self-proclaimed Turkish republic on Cyprus. She and her husband Hayri survived, and like many other families are waiting for news of their loved ones back in port as rescuers continue to search. "She was saying, 'Don't let go'. And I didn't let go of my daughter. I swear, I didn't let her go," Bicer told reporters through tears. Bicer said a suitcase fell on top of her, which forced her daughter from her grip. She managed to grab hold of her daughter's foot, but her shoes were coated in engine oil from the overturned vessel and she slipped through her hands. "It was slippery everywhere. It was like oil. stories.article_text_excerpt: Orangutans in danger as wildfires blaze through Borneo Orangutans in danger as wildfires blaze through Borneo Close A weak orangutan was found laying on the ground in Ketapang, West Kalimantan on Borneo island. Indonesia has intensified efforts to contain haze from wildfires across six provinces in Borneo and Sumatra islands. The wildfires have destroyed part of the habitat of hundreds of orangutans and risking the survival of the species. "The situation is quite critical", said Karmele Llano Sanchez, CEO of the wildlife foundation Yayasan Inisiasi Alam Rehabilitasi Indonesia (YIARI). Sanchez said the fires are "leaving [the orangutans] without any food or water". The orangutan found will be moved to a rehabilitation centre to get more treatment and will be released back into the wild after recovery, according to YIARI. stories.article_text_excerpt: The US military has carried out fresh strikes on Iranian rocket launchers in the Strait of Hormuz, the Associated Press reported, citing a US official.The unnamed official, who spoke on the condition of anonymity, said Iranian Revolutionary Guards (IRGC) forces had been observed preparing to launch rockets with sea mines into the Strait.In a statement, the IRGC confirmed strikes had hit Larak Island, resulting in an unspecified number of casualties, per Iran's Fars news agency.It also warned that the attack would be "met with a retaliatory response."The strikes mark the US's first military action in the Strait in a month.US Central Command leader Admiral Brad Cooper announced earlier this week that Iranian sea mines had been "successfully cleared" from the Strait's international shipping lanes.The Strait of Hormuz is a crucial energy transit chokepoint that usually carries around a quarter of the world’s seaborne oil trade. Iran effectively closed the waterway following US and Israeli strikes in late February, and it has since become a key sticking point in negotiations between Washington and Tehran.
